assignRefusedExplain: The one-to-one is part of the model, not a rule this screen applies: a project has one assignment record for its whole life. There is no reassignment — correct that record, or record a release date on it.
vesselAssignmentsExplain: Each project has exactly one vessel, for its whole life. There is no reassignment: a mistake is corrected on the single record, and an end of work is recorded as a release date.

vesselCorrectionNote: Changing this corrects which vessel the project is recorded against. It is not a reassignment — there is one record per project and no history of a previous vessel.
releaseDateNote: When this vessel’s work on the project ended. Leave empty while the work continues. It does not hand the project to another vessel.

roleCodeHint: Latin letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, up to 30. It cannot be changed after the role is added.
cyclesWithoutVolumeNote: Cycles with no dredged volume recorded
earnedValuePending: Not computed yet: this figure is not yet provided by the DMS service.
stoppageOutsideAvailability: Stoppage time outside the availability figure
kpiBasisAvailability: Cycle time / (cycle time + technical stoppage time + operational stoppage time), over approved reports. Cycle time runs from the start of dredging to the return to the dredging site. Planned and unclassified stoppage time is not in this figure; it is shown separately.
kpiBasisTechnical: Technical stoppage time / (cycle time + technical stoppage time + operational stoppage time), over approved reports.
kpiBasisOperational: Operational stoppage time / (cycle time + technical stoppage time + operational stoppage time), over approved reports.
kpiBasisOutside: Stoppage time in the planned category or in a category that is none of technical, operational or planned. It is not part of the availability denominator.
kpiBasisMeanCycle: Mean time per completed cycle, from the start of dredging to the return to the dredging site, over approved reports.
kpiBasisMeanVolume: Total dredged volume on approved reports / number of approved reports.
kpiBasisProgressAmended: Dredged volume on approved reports / the amended dredging volume.
kpiBasisProgressInitial: Dredged volume on approved reports / the initial dredging volume (no amended volume is recorded).
kpiBasisProgressMixed: Dredged volume on approved reports / the sum of each project's volume basis (the amended volume where recorded, otherwise the initial).
kpiReasonNoTime: No cycle time or technical or operational stoppage time on approved reports in this selection.
kpiReasonNoReports: No approved reports in this selection.
kpiReasonNoCycles: No approved cycles in this selection.
kpiReasonProgressVessel: Physical progress is a project figure; it is not computed for a single vessel.
kpiReasonNoProjects: There are no projects in this selection.
kpiReasonNoVolume: No dredging volume (initial or amended) is recorded for the project, so progress cannot be computed.
